verification.quote: A special tabulation of 2012 Census of Agriculture data for more than two thousand Utah farms revealed yields ranging from under 1 ton to more than 12 tons per acre. The median yield was 3.4 tons, and the average was 4 tons per acre.

I did not open the Utah condemnation statutes. Neither cited NASS source page gives a yield distribution.
